BRSA StudioSave your project before closing to keep your changes.

From design to a roomful of certificates.

  1. Upload your design. Use a PNG, JPG, or a PDF. For PDFs, the first page is the template.
  2. Import participants. Upload an Excel file or a CSV. For Google Forms, export the linked response spreadsheet first.
  3. Map your fields. Add text fields, choose a spreadsheet column or type fixed text, then drag them into place. Use percentage controls for precise placement.
  4. Review and download. Browse participants in the preview, then generate one PDF or a ZIP of separate PDFs.

Your files are processed in this browser. Save a project file to keep your work before closing the page. Standard fonts keep PDF text reliable. Characters outside the standard encoding use browser text rendering.
